character.name: A sleek, cloaked rogue in dark purple-black leather armor with thin gold trim running down the sides of the chest. Wears a dark hood or mask that covers most of the face with two small glowing amber/gold eyes visible. Carries a curved short blade or sickle-like dagger in the right hand. Slim, agile build. The palette is deep purple, near-black, and muted gold.
